report.summary: Surveillance view of a backyard at night where a person in white outerwear approaches a trampoline occupied by multiple bear cubs.

findings.observation: Multiple bear cubs remain positioned on the trampoline with very minimal movement throughout the sequence.

findings.category: spatial geometry, entrances, exits, paths, barriers, contact, scale, and physically possible movement
findings.observation: Figure in white suit walks from the wooden perimeter fence inward across the lawn toward the trampoline.

findings.category: spatial geometry, entrances, exits, paths, barriers, contact, scale, and physically possible movement
findings.observation: Figure reaches the edge of the trampoline and leans down near the border stones and frame.
